name: Editor UX Fix
description: Long-press a line to fold or unfold it (its parent if it has no children); click where the caret is to toggle the line; Alt+wheel (or wheel while holding the right button, on Windows) folds or unfolds the line under the mouse (its parent if it has no children) one level at a time, keeping the line under the mouse in place; the wheel left of the text (margin, indentation, list markers, heading #) steps just the range that spot belongs to, and a click there toggles it; header buttons step the whole document one level or fold/unfold everything.
author: Hyunyoung Park
